title: Software Developer with JetBrains IDEs
subtitle: Learn to program the way professional developers work: in JetBrains IDEs, from your first Python script to Java, web development and AI-assisted coding.
description: Start with Python in PyCharm, then keep your work in Git, debug and test it properly, and move on to Java in IntelliJ IDEA and to JavaScript and TypeScript in WebStorm. You finish with AI-assisted coding: using JetBrains AI Assistant and Junie well, and checking everything they suggest. Every course shows the IDE step by step, with its shortcuts for macOS, Windows and Linux, and has hands-on labs your instructors review.

title: Network Engineer
subtitle: Build, secure and automate networks with Cisco Packet Tracer, following the Cisco CCNA (200-301) exam topics from first principles to exam practice.
description: Learn how networks and the internet work, then address and subnet them, switch and route them, run their services, secure them and automate them with Python. Each course follows the published CCNA exam topics for its area, with labs in Cisco Packet Tracer, and the series ends with a full exam-preparation course. It's independent of Cisco and doesn't give you a Cisco certification, but it prepares you for the exam.

title: Cybersecurity Analyst
subtitle: Protect, monitor and respond: the defensive skills security teams hire for, practised on your own machine and realistic sample data.
description: Begin with the foundations of security, then learn to monitor systems and triage alerts, respond to incidents, write code that resists common attacks, secure cloud systems and use machine learning to spot threats. The labs use your own machine and sample logs and code that come with each course, and finish with a hardened Linux server of your own.

title: Generative AI Engineer
subtitle: Go from understanding generative AI to building, grounding, automating and testing applications with the Claude API.
description: Understand how generative AI works and how to prompt it well, then build applications with the Claude API in PyCharm: chat, streaming, tools and structured data. Ground answers in your own documents with retrieval, build agents that use tools safely, and prove your application works with evaluations and tests.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
subtitle: Learn machine learning from its foundations and statistics to deep learning, computer vision, language and running models in production.
description: Build models with scikit-learn on sound statistics, then train neural networks with PyTorch, work with images and text, and take models to production with tracking, serving, monitoring and retraining. Every course is hands-on in Python, in PyCharm.

title: Data Analyst
subtitle: Analyse data with Python, pandas and SQL, and back your conclusions with statistics.
description: Clean, explore and chart data with pandas, query databases with SQL in DataGrip, and use statistics to tell real effects from noise. Each course is hands-on, with datasets to work through.

title: AI for Business Leaders
subtitle: Understand AI, put it to work, and lead its use responsibly, without writing code.
description: Learn what AI is and isn't, how to choose where it pays off, how to use it every day at work, and how to govern it: fairness, transparency and the rules, including the EU AI Act.
